Name: Ponygirl Haley
Author: YukoValis
Description:
Ever want your own ponygirl to ride around town?  Well one bridle, blinders, and gag later got you your own pony girl transport.  Compliments of Haley.

This is my first mod and attempt at 8 bit art, but with that said, I spent a good amount of time on this.  I'm rather happy with the results.  I plan on making other females into farm animals, but this is a good first step to making a ponygirl theme farm.

Some of the sprite work was taken from Yunix93's nude overworld mod, who's page says I can edit stuff... so I kinda did.   Thank you Yunix93!
Feedback is always appreciated, as I will correct and improve.

NOTES: the horse is very difficult to edit facing the camera.  It doesn't look the best, but it is the only way I can make it work.  Your options and sprite space is VERY limited.  You might notice that climbing on when facing forward.  This also screws up the hats.

Nothing has changed with this sprite since 1.3, so it should still work.
